title: Without View and Manage AP/AR Data, New Customer has no Bill Invoices To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Customers → Create & Edit' but not 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', at the test location.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Customer window opens with its name and address fields.
  • No "Bill Invoices To" field shows.
  • No empty gap is left where the field would be: the fields above and below it sit next to each other.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-N1: “Without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', the field is hidden and the window closes up around it.”
  • Key Decisions: “Setting or removing a saved default Bill To needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' (the Credit Terms pattern).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "New Customer" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build), "Edit Customer" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • “No "Bill Invoices To" field; the window closes up around it.”
